description: This file defines the internal sealed class SiloMetadataSystemTarget, which implements interfaces for silo metadata management and lifecycle participation within the Orleans runtime. It provides a method to retrieve silo metadata and participates minimally in the lifecycle.

classes.name: SiloMetadataSystemTarget
classes.description: A sealed class that manages silo metadata and participates in the silo lifecycle within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Returns the current silo metadata wrapped in a completed task.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in the silo lifecycle, but does not perform any actions.
